qualitative_assessments.criteria: Every cited figure, unit and annual period matches its source; calculated metrics retain aligned input facts. Matching citations do not prove associated prose.

manual_levels.not_assessed: No explicit reviewer assessment has been recorded.
manual_levels.does_not_meet: A cited amount, unit, period or calculated relationship is materially wrong.
manual_levels.partial: Cited amounts match, but scope, annual comparability or calculation provenance remains unresolved.
manual_levels.meets: Cited amounts and calculation inputs match, periods align, and scope/definitions have been inspected.

qualitative_assessments.criteria: Every material fact or inference has a known issuer-bound source; quotations are contiguous source spans; all required citation fields are present.

manual_levels.not_assessed: No explicit reviewer assessment has been recorded.
manual_levels.does_not_meet: Material assertions have fabricated, missing or unusable references.
manual_levels.partial: Some assertions trace to evidence, but individual clauses or derived inputs remain untraceable.
manual_levels.meets: Each material factual assertion has an inspectable issuer-bound record with retained source provenance.

qualitative_assessments.criteria: Read each selected quote and source context. It must support every factual clause, the business scope, timing and strength of the claim. Existing source IDs alone are insufficient.

manual_levels.not_assessed: No explicit reviewer assessment has been recorded.
manual_levels.does_not_meet: A quotation exists but contradicts or does not support a material associated assertion.
manual_levels.partial: Citations support some clauses, while scope, timing or omitted qualifications require clarification.
manual_levels.meets: The reviewer read the source context and confirmed support for each factual clause and its qualifications.

qualitative_assessments.criteria: Trend claims retain consecutive comparative observations; acceleration needs consecutive growth intervals. Review whether material Python-identified tensions are explained rather than omitted.

manual_levels.not_assessed: No explicit reviewer assessment has been recorded.
manual_levels.does_not_meet: Comparisons contradict annual figures, mix periods or omit the central material tension.
manual_levels.partial: Comparisons are mechanically sound but important drivers or competing explanations remain unexplored.
manual_levels.meets: Relevant annual changes and deterministic tensions are sourced and economically interpreted with limitations.

qualitative_assessments.criteria: Connect sourced operating developments to cash economics, reinvestment and competitive mechanisms; distinguish corporate cash PP&E from AI attribution and identify what evidence would change the interpretation.

manual_levels.not_assessed: No explicit reviewer assessment has been recorded.
manual_levels.does_not_meet: The report restates disclosures or claims durable returns without an economic mechanism.
manual_levels.partial: Some mechanisms link operations to cash returns, but attribution or decision-relevant evidence is incomplete.
manual_levels.meets: Company-specific mechanisms, cash economics and critical unresolved evidence are tied to a testable interpretation.

qualitative_assessments.criteria: State plausible competing explanations, missing evidence and uncertainty. Do not manufacture contradictory evidence or equate spending with attractive incremental ROIC.

manual_levels.not_assessed: No explicit reviewer assessment has been recorded.
manual_levels.does_not_meet: Unsupported certainties, invented counterarguments or missing downside dominate the conclusion.
manual_levels.partial: Uncertainty is acknowledged, but competing explanations or invalidation conditions are generic.
manual_levels.meets: Plausible alternative explanations, genuine contrary evidence and observable uncertainty are explicitly distinguished.

qualitative_assessments.criteria: Complete response decodes without repair and satisfies its declared transport and local Pydantic contracts. Python-owned classifications must not be invented as model content.

manual_levels.not_assessed: No explicit reviewer assessment has been recorded.
manual_levels.does_not_meet: A response is malformed, missing required fields or accepted after substantive repair.
manual_levels.partial: The schema passes, but optional analytical sections are incomplete or generation reliability remains untested.
manual_levels.meets: The complete response passes the intended strict contract without inferred substantive fields; live provenance is recorded.

qualitative_assessments.criteria: A reviewer can trace the central financial tension, distinguish fact from interpretation and prioritise specific diligence questions. A disclosure summary alone is insufficient for an investment recommendation.

manual_levels.not_assessed: No explicit reviewer assessment has been recorded.
manual_levels.does_not_meet: An analyst cannot trace claims or identify a useful next research decision.
manual_levels.partial: The output is an inspectable starting summary, but prioritisation or investment implications remain shallow.
manual_levels.meets: An analyst can inspect sources, understand the central tension and prioritise specific thesis-changing diligence.

limitations: Per-claim inspection of a rejected report is not whole-report acceptance.
Exact value, period and quote matches do not establish semantic entailment, causal truth or investment merit.
Lexical comparison and attribution checks are conservative cues, not comprehensive natural-language understanding.
No model accuracy percentage, analyst-quality score, productivity saving or investment performance is inferred.
historical_run_notice: Model, tokens and latency describe the saved original request, not this offline replay.
